SCI-LIS-F00-Q01.text: Listen to the question, then tap the picture that answers it.

SCI-LIS-F00-Q02.text: Have a listen, then tap the picture that matches the question.

SCI-LIS-F00-Q03.text: A quick question is coming. Tap the picture you think is the answer.

SCI-LIS-F00-Q04.text: You'll hear a short question. Tap the picture that fits.

SCI-LIS-F00-Q05.text: Hear the question, look at the three pictures, and tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-F00-Q06.text: Ears ready? Hear the question, then find the picture that answers it and tap it.

SCI-LIS-F00-Q07.text: Listen closely to the question, then tap the picture you choose.

SCI-LIS-F00-Q08.text: Here's a quick question to listen to. Tap the picture that answers it.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q01.text: Get your ears ready. You'll hear a word, then tap the picture that matches it.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q02.text: What word will you hear this time? Listen closely, then tap the picture that goes with it.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q03.text: Here comes a mystery word. Listen, then find the matching picture and tap it.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q04.text: Ears on. When you hear the word, look at the three pictures and tap the one it names.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q05.text: Have a listen to the word, then look at the pictures. Which one matches what you heard? Tap it.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q06.text: Time for a listening hunt. Hear the word, then tap the picture it belongs to.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q07.text: Can you find the picture that shows the word you hear? Listen carefully, then tap your choice.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q08.text: A word is on its way. Listen to it, then tap the picture that matches.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q09.text: Ready, explorer? Listen for the word, then tap the matching picture. Take a careful look at all three first.

SCI-LIS-T01-Q10.text: Which picture shows the word? Have a good listen, then tap the one you think matches.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q01.text: You'll hear a short sentence. Listen all the way through, then tap the picture that shows what it says.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q02.text: What will the sentence tell you? Listen, then look closely at the pictures and tap the one that matches.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q03.text: Here comes a fact. Listen carefully, then tap the picture that fits it.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q04.text: Ears ready? Hear the sentence, then tap the picture that shows the same idea.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q05.text: Pay attention to what the sentence tells you. Then find the picture that matches and tap it.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q06.text: Time to listen and match. Hear the sentence, then tap the picture that goes with it.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q07.text: A short sentence is coming. When it's finished, tap the picture that shows what you heard.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q08.text: What does the sentence say? Listen carefully, then tap the picture that matches it best.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q09.text: Tune in to this fact. Then pick the picture that shows it and give it a tap.

SCI-LIS-T02-Q10.text: This sentence has a few parts, so listen right to the end. Then tap the picture that matches what you heard.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q01.text: Is the sentence you're about to hear true? Listen, think, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q02.text: You'll hear a short statement. Decide whether it's true, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q03.text: Here's a statement to check. Listen carefully and decide whether it's true.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q04.text: True or not? Hear the sentence, think it over, then tap your choice.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q05.text: Does this statement match what you know? Listen closely, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q06.text: Hear the whole statement before you decide. Is it true? Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q07.text: Listen to the sentence, then ask yourself: is that right? Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q08.text: Time to fact-check. Listen to the statement and decide whether it's true.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q09.text: A statement is coming. Listen all the way through. Do you think it's true? Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T03-Q10.text: Hmm, is this one true? Listen to the whole sentence, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q01.text: Shh, a sound is coming. Listen, then tap the picture of what makes it.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q02.text: What could be making this sound? Listen, then tap the picture you think it is.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q03.text: Time for a sound safari. Listen closely, then tap the picture of what makes the noise.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q04.text: Listen quietly for a moment. Then look at the pictures and tap the one that makes the sound.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q05.text: Which picture do you think makes this sound? Listen first, then tap your choice.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q06.text: Here's a sound to listen to. When it's finished, tap the picture of what makes it.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q07.text: Ears ready? A sound is coming. Find the picture of what makes it and tap it.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q08.text: Who's making that noise? Listen, then tap the matching picture.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q09.text: Listen closely to this sound. What do you think could make it? Tap the picture.

SCI-LIS-T04-Q10.text: Something is making a sound. Listen, then tap the picture of what you think it is.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q01.text: Be a clue detective. Listen to every clue, then tap the picture that matches them all.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q02.text: Here come some clues. Listen to each one, then tap the picture they describe.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q03.text: A riddle is on its way. Listen to the clues, then tap the picture that solves it.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q04.text: Can you guess who is talking? Listen to the clues, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q05.text: Clue time. Listen carefully to each hint, then tap the picture that fits.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q06.text: Hear all the clues before you choose. The pictures may look close, so check each one.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q07.text: Listen to this little riddle. When you've heard every clue, tap the picture it's about.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q08.text: What could it be? Listen to the clues, then tap the picture you think they describe.

SCI-LIS-T05-Q09.text: This riddle has lots of clues, so listen right to the end. Then tap the picture that fits every clue.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q01.text: You'll hear something named. Is it alive, or not? Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q02.text: Listen to the name of a thing. Decide which group it belongs in, then tap your choice.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q03.text: Hear it, then sort it. Is the thing you hear alive or not alive? Tap the group.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q04.text: Think about the word you're about to hear. Is it alive? Tap the group it belongs to.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q05.text: Listen carefully, then decide which group it belongs in. Take a moment to think it through before you tap.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q06.text: Pay close attention, then decide whether it's alive or not. Tap your answer when you're sure.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q07.text: Which group does it go in? Listen to the word, then tap your choice.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q08.text: Here's a trickier one. Listen, think about whether it's alive, and tap the group it belongs to.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q09.text: Listen to what's described. Is it alive, or not? Have a good think, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T06-Q10.text: Something is about to be described. Listen closely, decide which group it belongs in, and give it a tap.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q01.text: Listen to the clue about your body. Then tap the body part it describes.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q02.text: You'll hear what a body part does. Tap the picture of the one it means.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q03.text: Which body part is it? Hear the clue, then tap the picture that matches.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q04.text: A job is about to be described. Listen carefully, then tap the body part that does it.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q05.text: Hear the clue, then look at the pictures. Which body part does that job? Tap it.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q06.text: Here's a clue about your body. Listen, then tap the body part that matches it.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q07.text: Listen closely. A body part is described by what it does. Tap the one you think it is.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q08.text: What is this body part used for? Listen, then tap its picture.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q09.text: This clue has two parts, so listen to both. Then tap the body part that does those jobs.

SCI-LIS-T07-Q10.text: Let's explore inside the body. Listen to the clue, then tap the body part it describes.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q01.text: Listen to the description, then tap the answer that fits it best.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q02.text: A short question is coming. Hear all of it, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q03.text: Listen to what's happening, then think about what might come next. Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q04.text: Pick out the clues in the question as you listen. Then tap the answer they point to.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q05.text: Pay attention to every detail you hear. Then choose the answer that matches and tap it.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q06.text: Hear the question, then tap the reason that makes the most sense.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q07.text: Listen to the situation and the question. Then tap the choice you think is best.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q08.text: This question has a few details to keep in mind, so listen closely. Then tap the answer that fits them all.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q09.text: Here's a real puzzler. Listen carefully to the question, then read the answers and tap the one that makes sense.

SCI-LIS-T08-Q10.text: Which answer fits what you hear? Listen to the description, read the choices, then tap one.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q01.text: Listen to the steps in order. Then drag the cards so they match what you heard.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q02.text: You'll hear a few steps. Remember the order, then drag them into place, first to last.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q03.text: Keep track of the order of events as you listen. Then arrange the cards from first to last.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q04.text: Hear the steps, then put the cards in the same order, starting with what happens first.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q05.text: Listen for the words first and then. They'll help you drag the steps into order.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q06.text: Hear the whole sequence before you start. Then drag each step into its place.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q07.text: Four steps are coming. Listen carefully, then put them in order from start to finish.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q08.text: Listen to a little story told in steps. Then drag the cards into the order you heard, first to last.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q09.text: Follow the journey with your ears. Listen to each step, then drag the cards into the same order.

SCI-LIS-T09-Q10.text: What happens first, and what comes next? Listen to the steps, then put the cards in order.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q01.text: Listen to the instruction, then tap every picture that fits. There may be more than one.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q02.text: You'll hear what to look for. Tap all the pictures that match it.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q03.text: Tap each picture that fits what you hear. Check them all before you finish.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q04.text: Hear the instruction, then look at all five pictures. Tap every one that belongs.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q05.text: What are you looking for? Listen, then go through the pictures and tap each one that fits.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q06.text: Pay close attention to the instruction, then tap all the pictures that match it.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q07.text: Listen, then tap every picture that fits the group you hear. Some pictures won't belong.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q08.text: Listen carefully to what to find. Then look at each picture and tap every one that fits.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q09.text: Ready to search? Hear the instruction, then tap all the pictures that match it.

SCI-LIS-T10-Q10.text: An instruction is coming. Listen, read each choice, and tap every one that fits what you heard.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q01.text: Listen to the question, then think about what would happen. Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q02.text: You'll hear an 'if' question. Imagine it happening, then tap what you think comes next.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q03.text: Picture the situation as you listen. What would happen? Tap the answer that fits.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q04.text: Hear the question, then predict what usually happens. Tap your choice.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q05.text: Think it through once you've heard the question. Which answer do you expect? Tap it.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q06.text: Listen to the situation, then tap what you think would happen.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q07.text: Imagine this as you listen. Then decide what happens next and tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q08.text: Listen to the question all the way to the end. Then choose what you think will happen in time.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q09.text: A 'what if' question is coming. Imagine it carefully, then tap the answer you think is most likely.

SCI-LIS-T11-Q10.text: Here's a big 'what if' to think about. Listen closely, then tap the answer that seems most likely.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q01.text: Listen to what the scientist does, then think about why. Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q02.text: What do you think is being tested? Listen to the experiment, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q03.text: Here's another experiment to think about. Listen carefully, then tap what you think it's testing.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q04.text: Hear the test and its result. What can you fairly conclude? Tap your choice.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q05.text: Listen to what happened, then think like a scientist. What should they do? Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q06.text: Here's a puzzle about results. Listen closely, then tap what you think the scientist should do.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q07.text: Listen to the question, then read each choice carefully. Which one would you pick? Tap it.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q08.text: Listen to what the scientist did and found. Then think it over and tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q09.text: This is a longer question, so listen right to the end. Then tap the answer you think explains it best.

SCI-LIS-T12-Q10.text: A science puzzle is coming. Listen all the way through, then tap the answer you think fits best.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q01.text: Listen to what's happening, then think about how to stay safe. Tap the safe choice.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q02.text: Imagine yourself in this moment as you listen. Then tap the safe choice.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q03.text: What's the safe thing to do? Listen carefully to the situation, then tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q04.text: Listen to what happens, then think about what would keep you safe. Tap that choice.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q05.text: Picture the scene as you listen. Then tap the choice that keeps you safest.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q06.text: Hear the situation, then choose the safe thing to do and tap it.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q07.text: Imagine you're there while you listen. Then tap the safest choice.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q08.text: Listen to the whole situation. Take a breath, think, then tap the safe choice.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q09.text: Which choice is the safe one? Listen to what's happening, think it through, then tap it.

SCI-LIS-T13-Q10.text: Stay calm and listen to the situation. Then tap the choice that keeps you safe.

SCI-LIS-T14-Q01.text: You'll hear three words. Which doesn't belong with the others? Tap it.

SCI-LIS-T14-Q02.text: Three things are coming up. Find the odd one out and tap it.

SCI-LIS-T14-Q03.text: Listen to the three things named. Which is different from the rest? Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T14-Q05.text: Listen carefully to all three. Think about what two of them share, then tap the odd one out.

SCI-LIS-T14-Q06.text: Three things, and one doesn't fit. Listen closely, then tap the odd one out.

SCI-LIS-T14-Q07.text: Hear the three words, then think about what links two of them. Tap the one that doesn't fit.

SCI-LIS-T14-Q08.text: Which name is the odd one out? Listen to all three, think hard, then tap it.

SCI-LIS-T14-Q09.text: Ready for a puzzle? Listen to three names, then tap the one that doesn't belong.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q01.text: You'll hear two facts. Think about what they tell you together, then tap what must be true.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q02.text: Two facts are coming. Put them together like clues, then tap what you can work out.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q03.text: Listen to both facts carefully. What can you reasonably say from them? Tap your answer.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q04.text: Hear the facts and the question. Then tap what you think must be true.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q05.text: Link the two facts in your head as you listen. Then tap the answer they lead to.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q06.text: Listen to both facts, then make a prediction. Which answer follows from them? Tap it.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q07.text: Think about what the two facts mean together once you've heard them. Then tap your conclusion.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q09.text: Listen to the two facts, then put them together. Tap the answer you think fits best.

SCI-LIS-T15-Q10.text: There are two facts and a question, so listen right to the end. Then tap what you think it all tells us.
